title: This merge proposal will rename the sudo binary package to "sudo.ws", make sudo.ws provide the sudo virtual package, and adjust sudo.ws's prerm to allow removal if another sudo provider is present.
description:
This merge proposal will rename the sudo binary package to "sudo.ws", make sudo.ws provide the sudo virtual package, and adjust sudo.ws's prerm to allow removal if another sudo provider is present.

The intention behind this change is to allow for the sudo source package to be demoted to universe.

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~bamf0/+archive/ubuntu/stonking-sudo-universe-transition
PPA with all dependencies on sudo: https://launchpad.net/~bamf0/+archive/ubuntu/stonking-sudo-universe-transition-depends-sudo

Related MP: https://code.launchpad.net/~bamf0/ubuntu/+source/rust-sudo-rs/+git/rust-sudo-rs/+merge/510660

index fa5d051..59a2a11 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,15 @@
+sudo (1.9.17p2-7ubuntu4) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * Prepare for transition of sudo to universe (LP: #2153145)
+    - Rename sudo binary package to "sudo.ws":
+      + d/control: Change binary package name and add Provides sudo
+      + d/rules: Change sudo occurrences to sudo.ws
+      + debian/*: Rename maintainer scripts to use the sudo.ws prefix
+    - d/sudo.ws.prerm: Allow sudo.ws to be removed if another sudo provider
+      is installed
+
+ -- Simon Johnsson <simon.johnsson@canonical.com>  Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:53:31 +0200
+
 sudo (1.9.17p2-7ubuntu3) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   * d/t/04-getroot-sssd: adjust slapd apparmor for autopkgtests

index 1503418..8650b84 100644
--- a/debian/sudo.prerm
+++ b/debian/sudo.ws.prerm
@@ -2,6 +2,28 @@
 
 set -e
 
+has_other_sudo_provider() {
+	providers=$(
+		dpkg-query -W \
+			-f='${db:Status-Status}\t${Package}\t${Provides}\n' 2>/dev/null
+	) || return 1
+
+	while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r status package provides; do
+		[ "$status" = "installed" ] || continue
+		[ "$package" = "sudo.ws" ] && continue
+
+        printf '%s\n' "$provides" |
+			tr ',' '\n' |
+			sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' |
+			grep -q '^sudo$' &&
+			return 0
+	done <<EOF
+$providers
+EOF
+
+	return 1
+}
+
 check_password() {
     if [ ! "$SUDO_FORCE_REMOVE" = "yes" ]; then
 	# let's check whether the root account is locked.
@@ -18,8 +40,9 @@ check_password() {
 	# installing packages).
 	if [ "x$passwd" = "x*" ] || [ "x$passwd1" = "x!" ]; then
 	    # yup, password is locked
-	    echo "You have asked that the sudo package be removed,"
-	    echo "but no root password has been set."
+	    echo "You have asked that the sudo.ws package be removed,"
+	    echo "but no root password has been set, and sudo.ws is the only"
+	    echo "provider of sudo on the system."
 	    echo "Without sudo, you may not be able to gain administrative privileges."
 	    echo
 	    echo "If you would prefer to access the root account with su(1)"
@@ -36,10 +59,12 @@ check_password() {
 	fi
     fi
 }
-	
+
 case $1 in
 	remove)
-		check_password;
+		if ! has_other_sudo_provider; then
+			check_password
+		fi
 		;;
 	*)
 		;;
